title: SUPPER IN THE COMMON KITCHEN
content: The kitchen fills gradually. Someone has put rice on, another is chopping vegetables, and a third is trying to rescue a pan from yesterday. The conversation moves between coursework, a new record, and who has borrowed the good screwdriver. Nobody eats alone unless he wants to.
